observations: Most Popular's 100 games came back in exactly yesterday's order, with no entries or exits. That is unusual enough that today's capture may be a carry-over, so movement-based reads on this chart should wait a day.
Steal An Egg (76 days) still leads, with Brookhaven, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Murder Mystery 2, 99 Nights in the Forest and RIVALS behind it.
By age, games past a year hold the best median pillar percentile (62), while 43-84 day games (38) and 4-12 month games (36) trail. That keeps the mid-life trough idea (H-mp-009) alive.
The weakest positions belong to Ghost Driver, BedWars, Kart Of Hell and RUNAWAYS, all mid-life or older games without a strong social hook.
patterns: Higher-priced passes (median above 149 R$) tend to go with higher peak and current positions (rho +0.34 and +0.30; H-mp-001 at 63%).
All-caps titles (r -0.45) and like-begging descriptions (r -0.34) tend to sit lower, likely marking quick clones.

Novelty showed a positive rank correlation today (+0.24) and is now being tested on position. Among profiled games, roleplay (68), sports (68) and combat PvP (66) lead on median percentile, and wave-survival (22) and party (24) loops trail.
A higher favorite rate per visit again goes with lower positions (rho -0.38), consistent with huge evergreens converting a smaller share of visits into favorites.

outliers.name: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Candy & Chocolate
outliers.note: An '+1' incremental near the top of Most Popular, though '+1' games sit low elsewhere. Its 44 passes and 203 products suggest a heavily live-operated template rather than a typical clone.

outliers.name: BedWars
outliers.note: A 5-year-old PvP game with 49 passes near the bottom, which goes against the pass-price and combat-loop patterns. It is likely in late-life decline despite a rerelease tag.

observations: The chart shrank from 497 to 476 rows, with 15 entries and 36 exits. Several exits are 18+ voice-chat rooms (Neighbors, The Corner), so the 18+ rows look unpatched in today's capture.
Donation hubs again lead efficiency (Donation Central, Summer Donations, Simple DONATIONS), followed by evil plate game and Korea Army.
Young breakouts climbed fast as revenue caught up: Peel THE Potato rose 103 places and Build a Phone Empire 97, which fits H-te-018.
Games 15-42 days old sit at the 20th efficiency percentile versus the 58th past a year, and the lifecycle gap holds for a fourth day.
patterns: Complexity (rho +0.28), longer descriptions (+0.26), median product price above 79 R$ (r +0.32) and RPG genre (+0.38) remain the strongest positive signals, all sitting just under the 70% line.
'Egg' (r -0.58), 'Steal' (-0.40) and anime themes (-0.33 to -0.37) remain the weakest title signals. Pet/egg mechanics are also negative (-0.23).
All-caps titles go with better efficiency here (r +0.29), the opposite of their sign on Most Popular. This may reflect hype-styled donation or event titles, and is being tested today.
Tower defense (86) and idle tycoon (69) lead profiled loops on efficiency, while obby (3), sandbox (17) and '+1' incrementals (19) trail.

outliers.name: Fish It!
outliers.note: Huge CCU with a mid-chart earning position gives it the worst efficiency despite 269 products. Scale, not weak monetization, likely drives this.

outliers.name: Strikeborn
outliers.note: A 44-day-old game with no passes and 19 products among the most efficient. Its small CCU makes it vulnerable to the single-snapshot caveat (H-te-019).

observations: Turnover stayed high: 29 entries and 28 exits. Big evergreens (Jujutsu Shenanigans at #4, Berry Avenue, Fisch) re-entered alongside young egg and party games.
Among games under 4 months, Lift Rock For Eggs (12 days), Climb For Animals Eggs, Board Of Hell and Peel THE Potato showed the strongest momentum.
COCARDO (+38), Hide In Pixels (+37), Makeup Mania (+34) and Build An Ant Empire (+33) rose most. I Can Read Your Mind (-52), NEYMAR PRISON RUN (-49) and Shrink Hide & Seek (-44) fell hardest.
Games 85-122 days old scored a high median (86, n=6), but the group is small. The 43-84 day band trails at 38.
patterns: Pet and egg mechanics go with higher positions among same-age young games (within-age +0.39). The 'Egg' keyword is positive here (+0.35) even as it is the worst keyword on Top Earning.
Upgrade-heavy (r -0.37) and build mechanics (-0.43) may slow momentum, echoing the '+1' slump. Incremental '+1' loops sit at a median 9th percentile.
PvP loops may climb more slowly among same-age games (within-age -0.60), and mixed-social loops may climb faster (+0.31).
Page videos and verified creators again go with slower climbs (-0.35, -0.36). This may be speculative noise or a sign that studio launches peak early.

outliers.name: Board Of Hell
outliers.note: At 120 days it shows top-tier momentum, well past the 6-week cutoff in H-tt-001. Obby-variant series seem to keep resurfacing.

outliers.name: DON'T LET HIM IN
outliers.note: Rose 28 places but scores among the weakest on momentum measured across days, a sign of a volatile rather than steady climb.

observations: Get Your Driver's License! (10 days) leads despite a 32% like ratio, followed by Huss Valley, Sarab, COCARDO, Break and Steal an Egg and Firefighting Sim.
8 games entered (including Don't Be Late For Work!, PORTALS, Archer and two '+1' games) and 12 left. Several steal and '+1' titles exited (Steal An EXE Egg, Steal ASMR, +1 SCP Evolution).
Sell Fries! [Anomaly] (+30), Makeup Mania (+29) and two egg games rose. The chore sims Cut all the Grass (-41) and Melt All The Ice (-35) fell sharply after their peak.
Games 14 days or younger hold a median percentile of 59 versus 46 for 15-42 days.
patterns: Everyday-job sims lead loops (r +0.44, median 69; H-uc-009 at 59%), though today's falls of the chore sims suggest these breakouts are short-lived.
'+1' incrementals remain the weakest group (r -0.36 to -0.40; H-uc-003 59%).
Horror-escape loops hold the best median percentile (85, n=4), led by Sarab and COCARDO; added as a qualitative idea.

Cheaper passes (median at or below 89 R$) and descriptions asking for favorites may go with higher positions (-0.26 and within-age +0.42); both are now under test. Solo loops still tend to rank lower (within-age -0.23).

outliers.name: Get Your Driver's License!
outliers.note: Tops the chart with a 32% like ratio, which may explain why H-uc-006 (like ratio) keeps weakening: a novel real-life premise seems to outweigh reception early on.

outliers.name: MM2 of The Locust
outliers.note: A 16-day horror-escape game near the bottom while two younger horror escapes sit near the top, which fits a quick rise-and-fade shape.

summary: Eggs split the charts: pet/egg games tend to hold higher Top Trending positions among young games (+0.40) but earn the weakest efficiency on Top Earning ('Egg' r -0.58). Steal titles have lost their Up-and-Coming edge (H-uc-002 down to 46%).

Price signals flip by lifecycle: higher pass prices go with higher Most Popular positions (+0.30) and better Top Earning efficiency (+0.15), but with lower Up-and-Coming positions (-0.26). This may mean breakouts launch cheap and raise prices later.
All-caps titles also flip: lower on Most Popular (-0.45) but more efficient on Top Earning (+0.29).
Upgrade mechanics and page videos go with weaker breakout momentum on both Top Trending and Up-and-Coming.
Most hypotheses still sit between 50% and 69%. With only 3-4 days per chart, none has crossed 70%, and today's identical Most Popular order adds no new movement evidence.
progressions: Real chart entries since tracking began: Top Trending 45, Up-and-Coming 26, Top Earning 22, Most Popular 13.

Entries by games already on another chart: Top Trending to Most Popular 10 (median 2 days), Up-and-Coming to Top Trending 9 (1 day), Top Earning to Top Trending 7 (2 days), Top Earning to Up-and-Coming 6 (3 days), Up-and-Coming to Top Earning 6 (1 day), Up-and-Coming to Most Popular 5 (1 day).
The Up-and-Coming to Top Trending to Most Popular path remains the most common, and today's young risers on Top Earning (Peel THE Potato, Firefighting Sim) were already on Up-and-Coming.
